# krcw: paced
# KRCW America on_actions (generated by build/content_america.py, part am_p8_onactions)
# Owned by the "america" content agent. Mississippi Line = global.krcw_ohio_tension.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = WCA } WCA = { country_event = { id = krcw_ampre.1 days = 2 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = USA } USA = { country_event = { id = krcw_ampre.2 days = 2 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = PSA } PSA = { country_event = { id = krcw_ampre.3 days = 2 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CAN } CAN = { country_event = { id = krcw_ampre.4 days = 2 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = PSA } PSA = { recruit_character = PSA_krcw_martin } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.krcw_ohio_tension } } set_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension = 45 } }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = USA }
				USA = {
					country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.1 days = 4 }
					add_ideas = { krcw_usa_machine_corruption krcw_usa_color_line }
					# 1952 election cycle
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.20 days = 603 random_days = 12 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.21 days = 632 random_days = 4 }
					# Huey Long's illness (spring 1953) and death (10 September 1953)
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.30 days = 686 random_days = 16 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.31 days = 768 random_days = 8 }
					# recurring pressure from the colour line
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.14 days = 400 random_days = 126 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_usa.14 days = 992 random_days = 169 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = WCA }
				WCA = {
					country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.1 days = 4 }
					add_ideas = { krcw_wca_syndicate_factionalism krcw_wca_appalachian_front }
					# syndicate factionalism and the Appalachian rebuild keep biting
					country_event = { id = krcw_wca.11 days = 315 random_days = 105 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_wca.12 days = 442 random_days = 126 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_wca.13 days = 738 random_days = 169 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Mississippi Line, west bank
	on_monthly_USA = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_active
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_restarted }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_over }
					country_exists = WCA
					NOT = { has_war_with = WCA }
				}
					random_list = {
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.10 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.12 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.14 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.15 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.17 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.19 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						40 = { }
					}
				# tension decays slowly toward the armistice baseline when nobody stokes it
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension > 45 } krcw_low_tension = yes }
					subtract_from_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension = 1 }
				}
				# the brink: a crisis on the line
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension > 84 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_usa_brink_seen }
					}
					set_country_flag = krcw_usa_brink_seen
					country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.40 days = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = krcw_usa_brink_seen
						check_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension < 70 }
					}
					clr_country_flag = krcw_usa_brink_seen
				}
			}
			# the southern generals' second attempt never expires while they are unchecked
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = krcw_usa_generals_unchecked
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_usa_junta_rule }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_usa_generals_dispersed }
					date > 1952.11.23
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_usa_second_chance_seen }
				}
				set_country_flag = krcw_usa_second_chance_seen
				country_event = { id = krcw_usa.37 days = 10 }
			}
			# after renewed war has ground on a while, the mediators try again
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_restarted
					has_war_with = WCA
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_usa_stl_talks_seen }
					OR = { surrender_progress > 0.15 WCA = { surrender_progress > 0.15 } }
				}
				set_country_flag = krcw_usa_stl_talks_seen
				country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.60 days = 5 }
			}
		}
	}

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Mississippi Line, east bank
	on_monthly_WCA = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_active
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_restarted }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_over }
					country_exists = USA
					NOT = { has_war_with = USA }
				}
					random_list = {
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.10 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.11 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.13 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.16 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.18 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						10 = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.19 days = 3 random_days = 20 } }
						40 = { }
					}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension > 84 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_wca_brink_seen }
					}
					set_country_flag = krcw_wca_brink_seen
					country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.41 days = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_country_flag = krcw_wca_brink_seen
						check_variable = { global.krcw_ohio_tension < 70 }
					}
					clr_country_flag = krcw_wca_brink_seen
				}
			}
			# Long's death is felt on the east bank too
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_long_dead
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_wca_long_death_seen }
				}
				set_country_flag = krcw_wca_long_death_seen
				country_event = { id = krcw_wca.20 days = 3 }
			}
		}
	}

	# one side has been eliminated -- clean up the war state
	on_annex = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_restarted
					OR = { NOT = { country_exists = USA } NOT = { country_exists = WCA } }
				}
				country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.63 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	on_capitulation = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_american_war_restarted
					OR = { tag = USA tag = WCA }
					FROM = { OR = { tag = USA tag = WCA } }
				}
				FROM = { country_event = { id = krcw_ohio.63 days = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
